lines.zh: 齿轮转得飞快，我一步跨过两块石砖。
lines.en: My gears spin fast; I cross two stone bricks per step.

lines.zh: 短腿配长弹簧，追你时绝不会喘气。
lines.en: Short legs and long springs; I never get winded chasing you.

lines.zh: 兵工厂给我的腿装了偏心轮，跑起来有点歪。
lines.en: The foundry fitted offset cams, so I run a little crooked.

lines.zh: 我踩着油迹走，脚印一路都是黑亮的。
lines.en: I walk over oil stains, leaving glossy black footprints.

lines.zh: 别看我小，冲刺时膝盖会发出哨声。
lines.en: Small as I am, my knees whistle when I sprint.

lines.zh: 沿着走廊直线走，转弯要提前半步。
lines.en: I keep straight down corridors and start turns half a step early.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌是铸钢的，落地声像敲钉子。
lines.en: My soles are cast steel; each step lands like a hammered nail.

lines.zh: 走近路，别绕远，我的发条没那么多圈。
lines.en: Take the short way; my mainspring has only so many turns.

lines.zh: 这块地砖松了，我踩上去会歪一下。
lines.en: This tile is loose; I tilt a little when I step on it.

lines.zh: 我巡逻的路线是出厂时就刻好的。
lines.en: My patrol route was stamped into me at the factory.

lines.zh: 速度是我的全部本钱，停下就露馅了。
lines.en: Speed is all I have; standing still gives me away.

lines.zh: 我从不多走一步，只算最短的直线。
lines.en: I never take an extra step, only the shortest line.

lines.zh: 关节里塞着旧棉纱，走快了会冒烟。
lines.en: Old cotton waste packs my joints; going fast makes them smoke.

lines.zh: 前面有台阶，我得蹦一下才上得去。
lines.en: There are steps ahead; I must hop to get up them.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己的影子跑，它追不上。
lines.en: I run over my own shadow; it cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 脚踝的轴响了一声，我照旧往前。
lines.en: My ankle axle clicks once; I keep going.

lines.zh: 发条松了，我站着慢慢数自己的齿轮。
lines.en: My spring winds down; I stand counting my own gears.

lines.zh: 油壶空了，肩膀转起来有沙沙声。
lines.en: The oil can is empty; my shoulders rasp when they turn.

lines.zh: 兵工厂的编号还烙在我后颈上。
lines.en: The foundry's serial number is still branded on my neck.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，就是为了让你先动。
lines.en: I hold still so that you move first.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我能听见远处铁砧的回声。
lines.en: In the quiet I hear an anvil echoing far off.

lines.zh: 我在等发条重新绷紧，别急。
lines.en: I am waiting for my spring to tighten again; be patient.

lines.zh: 身上掉漆的地方，露出底下的灰铁。
lines.en: Where the paint flaked, grey iron shows through.

lines.zh: 我没装肺，所以不会叹气，只会咔哒。
lines.en: I have no lungs, so I click instead of sighing.

lines.zh: 眼睛是两片玻璃，蒙了灰就看得慢。
lines.en: My eyes are two glass discs; dust makes me slow to see.

lines.zh: 我数到一百就自己上弦，现在到七十三。
lines.en: I rewind at one hundred; I am at seventy-three.

lines.zh: 站久了，脚底会陷进软土里。
lines.en: Stand long enough and my soles sink into soft soil.

lines.zh: 我不睡觉，只是把速度调到最低。
lines.en: I do not sleep; I just drop my speed to its lowest.

lines.zh: 工头说待命也要保持半蹲。
lines.en: The foreman says even standby is done half-crouched.

lines.zh: 我这副架子，安静比吵闹更吓人。
lines.en: This frame of mine is scarier quiet than loud.

lines.zh: 我把手举在半空，忘了放下来。
lines.en: I hold my hand mid-air and forget to lower it.

lines.zh: 背后那台机器在打拍子，我跟着数。
lines.en: The machine behind me keeps time; I count along.

lines.zh: 你的脖子比我的目标还高，我记下了。
lines.en: Your neck sits higher than my target; noted.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖，那里离我最近。
lines.en: I watch your knees; they are closest to me.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我的玻璃眼不会眨。
lines.en: Do not blink; my glass eyes cannot.

lines.zh: 兵工厂给的短刀够用。
lines.en: The arsenal's short blade is enough.

lines.zh: 我把你从头到脚量了一遍，九十七步。
lines.en: I measured you head to toe: ninety-seven steps.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾了泥，跑起来会打滑。
lines.en: Your boots are muddy; you will slip when you run.

lines.zh: 我抬头只为看清你的咽喉位置。
lines.en: I look up only to find where your throat is.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，我的发条立刻紧了。
lines.en: You stepped back half a pace; my spring tightened at once.

lines.zh: 你这身高，正好一刺够到腰。
lines.en: At your height, one thrust reaches your waist.

lines.zh: 我记住了你的味道，铁的，还有汗。
lines.en: I have your scent: iron, and sweat.

lines.zh: 你一直看我，是在找我的接缝吗？
lines.en: Staring at me; looking for my seams?

lines.zh: 别把手放低，我会以为你要拔刀。
lines.en: Do not drop your hand; I will think you are drawing a blade.

lines.zh: 凹了一块，不影响我刺你。
lines.en: A dent; it does not stop me stabbing you.

lines.zh: 铆钉崩了，肩膀开始晃。
lines.en: A rivet popped; my shoulder is wobbling.

lines.zh: 别打关节，那是我的弱点。
lines.en: Not the joints; that is my weak spot.

lines.zh: 我听见自己里面有东西断了。
lines.en: I heard something snap inside me.

lines.zh: 疼？我不知道，我只知道慢了。
lines.en: Pain? I do not know it, only slowing down.

lines.zh: 你敲掉了我半颗玻璃眼。
lines.en: You knocked out half a glass eye.

lines.zh: 我的油漏在地上，滑得很。
lines.en: My oil is leaking; the floor is slick.

lines.zh: 这一下让我少转了半圈。
lines.en: That cost me half a turn of the crank.

lines.zh: 别以为铁不会怕，我怕散架。
lines.en: Do not think iron feels nothing; I fear falling apart.

lines.zh: 我还能动，发条还有三圈。
lines.en: I can still move; three turns left in the spring.

lines.zh: 是机油吗？我关节正缺这个。
lines.en: Is that machine oil? My joints are short of it.

lines.zh: 你把油壶放下，我就不追了。
lines.en: Set the oil can down and I will stop chasing.

lines.zh: 那种粘稠的味道，让我齿轮发痒。
lines.en: That thick smell makes my gears itch.

lines.zh: 给我一滴就够，我只要润滑。
lines.en: One drop is enough; I only want lubrication.

lines.zh: 我闻到了黄油，别藏在背后。
lines.en: I smell grease; do not hide it behind your back.

lines.zh: 你手上那块抹布，能擦我的眼睛吗？
lines.en: Could that rag in your hand clean my eyes?

lines.zh: 发条钥匙！你居然有发条钥匙！
lines.en: A winding key! You actually have a winding key!

lines.zh: 我跟着油味走，别的我都不认。
lines.en: I follow the smell of oil; nothing else counts.

lines.zh: 那罐东西，比你的命值钱多了。
lines.en: That tin is worth far more than your life.

lines.zh: 你晃一晃油瓶，我就乖乖站住。
lines.en: Swirl the oil bottle and I will stand still.

lines.zh: 我饿，但铁不吃面包，只喝油。
lines.en: I hunger, but iron eats no bread, only oil.

lines.zh: 我凑这么近，只是想舔壶口。
lines.en: I come this close only to lick the spout.

lines.zh: 别拿水糊弄我，我要的是润滑油。
lines.en: Do not fool me with water; I want lubricant.

lines.zh: 你给油，我就当没看见你。
lines.en: Give me oil and I will pretend I never saw you.

lines.zh: 你袖口有一圈黑油，我看见了。
lines.en: There is a ring of black oil on your cuff.

lines.zh: 你把壶嘴递过来，我就跟着走。
lines.en: Hold out the spout, and I will follow you.

lines.zh: 撞上我，等于撞上一截铁轨。
lines.en: Hitting me is like hitting a length of rail.

lines.zh: 你撞得我歪了半圈，我记仇。
lines.en: You knocked me half a turn off; I hold grudges.

lines.zh: 让开，我的冲量不会为你拐弯。
lines.en: Move; my momentum does not turn for you.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀有铆钉，撞了会疼。
lines.en: My shoulder is riveted; that collision will hurt.

lines.zh: 别用身体试探我，我的边框是实心的。
lines.en: Do not test me with your body; my frame is solid.

lines.zh: 你碰掉了我一块漆，赔。
lines.en: You chipped my paint. Pay for it.

lines.zh: 我们错身的时候，你听见金属声了吗？
lines.en: When we passed, did you hear metal?

lines.zh: 我被撞得退了两步，这很丢脸。
lines.en: You knocked me back two steps; humiliating.

lines.zh: 我的重心低，撞不倒，只会弹。
lines.en: My center is low; I do not fall, I bounce.

lines.zh: 再挤一次，我就把你当靶子。
lines.en: Shove once more and I will count you as a target.

lines.zh: 配对？兵工厂只会成批铸我。
lines.en: Pairing? The foundry only casts me in batches.

lines.zh: 我见过和我一样的，编号差三位。
lines.en: I have met my double; his number differs by three.

lines.zh: 两个我站一起，会互相卡住齿轮。
lines.en: Two of me would jam each other's gears.

lines.zh: 我们没有亲缘，只有同一副模具。
lines.en: We share no blood, only the same mold.

lines.zh: 你想看我们并排冲刺吗？
lines.en: Want to see us sprint side by side?

lines.zh: 我的同类不会拥抱，只会撞肩。
lines.en: My kind does not embrace; we knock shoulders.

lines.zh: 发条同步的时候，我们像一对钟。
lines.en: When our springs sync, we sound like a pair of clocks.

lines.zh: 别指望小铁块生出小铁块。
lines.en: Do not expect little iron to birth little iron.

lines.zh: 工头把成对的我们装箱发走。
lines.en: The foreman boxes us in pairs and ships us out.

lines.zh: 我认得出同炉的，声音一样。
lines.en: I know my batch-mates; we sound the same.

lines.zh: 地上那枚铁粒，我弯腰捡了。
lines.en: That iron nugget on the ground; I bent and took it.

lines.zh: 我只捡金属，木棍留给别人。
lines.en: I pick up only metal; leave the sticks to others.

lines.zh: 这块废铁能补我左肋的缺口。
lines.en: This scrap can patch the gap in my left ribs.

lines.zh: 别捡，那是我掉的螺丝。
lines.en: Do not take that; it is a screw I dropped.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进胸腔，当备用零件。
lines.en: I tuck it into my chest as a spare part.

lines.zh: 剑我拿不稳，但钉子我拿得牢。
lines.en: A sword slips in my grip; a nail does not.

lines.zh: 捡起来的东西，我会先咬一下。
lines.en: Whatever I pick up, I bite once to test it.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，落到我脚边就归我。
lines.en: What you drop at my feet belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我收集所有能拧动的东西。
lines.en: I collect anything that can be turned with a wrench.

lines.zh: 这块铁片太薄，做不了刀刃。
lines.en: This plate is too thin to make a blade.

lines.zh: 你走进我的射程，我就锁定了。
lines.en: You entered my reach; I have locked on.

lines.zh: 目标确认：一个，会跑，没穿甲。
lines.en: Target confirmed: one, runs, unarmored.

lines.zh: 我的突刺只练过一种角度。
lines.en: My lunge has been drilled at exactly one angle.

lines.zh: 别怪我，是编号叫我动手的。
lines.en: Do not blame me; my serial number ordered it.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，就再也不会看别处。
lines.en: Now that I see you, I look nowhere else.

lines.zh: 目标登记完成，接下来是距离。
lines.en: Target logged; next comes distance.

lines.zh: 你身上有我需要的热量，站住。
lines.en: You carry the heat I need; stand still.

lines.zh: 我选你，因为你离我最近。
lines.en: I chose you because you are nearest.

lines.zh: 我不是猎手，我是被派来的刀。
lines.en: I am no hunter; I am a dispatched blade.

lines.zh: 锁定之后，我的腿就不听话了。
lines.en: Once locked, my legs stop taking orders.

lines.zh: 我在算三步的距离，别动。
lines.en: I am measuring three steps; stay still.

lines.zh: 你往左挪，我就往左偏一点。
lines.en: Shift left and I lean left a little.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖在抖，那是蓄力。
lines.en: My knees are shaking; that is the wind-up.

lines.zh: 别退到墙角，那样我更好刺。
lines.en: Do not back into a corner; it makes the thrust easier.

lines.zh: 我把重心压低了，下一瞬就到你面前。
lines.en: I have dropped my weight; next instant I am on you.

lines.zh: 你的破绽在转身那半秒。
lines.en: Your opening is the half second you turn.

lines.zh: 我在等你的脚落地，那一瞬最慢。
lines.en: I wait for your foot to land; that is your slowest instant.

lines.zh: 别看我手里的尖，看我的脚。
lines.en: Do not watch my point; watch my feet.

lines.zh: 数到三我就冲，你最好先跑。
lines.en: I charge at three; you had better run first.

lines.zh: 我瞄准的是膝盖，不是胸口。
lines.en: I aim at the knee, not the chest.

lines.zh: 一刺，收，退半步，这就是全部。
lines.en: One thrust, withdraw, half a step back; that is everything.

lines.zh: 我的尖只进一寸，够了。
lines.en: My point goes in one inch; that suffices.

lines.zh: 别指望我挥砍，我只会往前捅。
lines.en: Do not expect a swing; I only stab forward.

lines.zh: 这一下是出厂时就练好的。
lines.en: This stroke was drilled into me at the factory.

lines.zh: 你的护甲缝在腋下，我找到了。
lines.en: Your armor gap is under the arm; I found it.

lines.zh: 我刺完会僵一瞬，趁那时打我。
lines.en: I lock up for an instant after a thrust; hit me then.

lines.zh: 别用手挡，我的尖会穿过去。
lines.en: Do not block with your hand; my point goes through.

lines.zh: 我不是在砍你，是在给你钻孔。
lines.en: I am not slashing you; I am drilling you.

lines.zh: 这一击用的是整条弹簧的力。
lines.en: This blow spends the whole spring's force.

lines.zh: 你流血了，我的活干完了。
lines.en: You bleed; my work is done.

lines.zh: 流水线停了，我被推到光里。
lines.en: The line stopped and I was pushed into the light.

lines.zh: 出厂的第一次上弦，咔哒一声。
lines.en: Wound for the first time out of the factory; one click.

lines.zh: 我从箱子里爬出来，纸屑还挂着。
lines.en: I climbed from the crate, packing straw still on me.

lines.zh: 谁把我放这儿的？地砖好凉。
lines.en: Who placed me here? The tiles are cold.

lines.zh: 编号七，兵工厂出品，报到。
lines.en: Serial seven, foundry-made, reporting.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼就在找最近的活人。
lines.en: I opened my eyes already hunting the nearest living thing.

lines.zh: 工头没来送我，只有一盏油灯。
lines.en: The foreman did not see me off, only an oil lamp.

lines.zh: 我的漆还没干，别碰我肩膀。
lines.en: My paint is still wet; do not touch my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这地方的风里有铁锈味。
lines.en: The wind here smells of rust.

lines.zh: 我刚被拧紧，现在想试试腿。
lines.en: I was just tightened; now I want to test my legs.

lines.zh: 火烤得我漆起泡，油要着了。
lines.en: The flames blister my paint; my oil is catching.

lines.zh: 落地时，我的腿弯成了奇怪的角度。
lines.en: I landed with my legs bent at a strange angle.

lines.zh: 水灌进齿轮，我转不动了。
lines.en: Water in my gears; I cannot turn.

lines.zh: 冲击把我半个胸腔掀开了。
lines.en: The blast peeled half my chest open.

lines.zh: 箭卡在我肋骨的缝里，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow is stuck in my rib gap.

lines.zh: 那股光让我的发条自己倒转。
lines.en: That glow runs my spring backwards.

lines.zh: 没有油，我的关节开始尖叫。
lines.en: No oil, and my joints begin to scream.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，玻璃眼全白了。
lines.en: Lightning struck me; my glass eyes went white.

lines.zh: 我在下坠，齿轮已经不带声音。
lines.en: I am falling, and my gears make no sound.
